issues.title: Enhanced graphics bake fails on PAL level_11: "invalid medial field connection in room 0 (swimming true)"
issues.author: damixadkatakara
issues.body:
Launcher version:0.10.0
Game: Ratchet & Clank
OS: Windows
What happens:
When baking the lighting (Enhanced graphics), the bake fails on level_11 with:
openrac-bake-error: "The lighting tool could not finish", stage "Bake and verify grids", level "level_11", failed_levels: 1
The native baker (openrac-probe-bake.exe, --threads 5, --resume) exits with status 1. The last line of its output is:
probe bake: invalid medial field connection in room 0 (swimming true): 404.25 531.75 223 to 405 532…
